title: Family
definition: Family is the foundational relationship structure established by God for nurturing, support, discipleship, love, responsibility, and spiritual growth.
summary: The family is one of God's primary institutions for shaping character, teaching truth, providing care, and strengthening relationships. Families are intended to be places where faith is modeled, love is demonstrated, and spiritual growth is encouraged. Because families are made up of imperfect people, they often experience conflict, disappointment, and challenges. Yet God provides grace, wisdom, and guidance for families seeking to honor Him.
christFocus: Jesus honored family relationships while teaching that devotion to God remains the highest priority. Through Christ, believers also become part of God's spiritual family.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Strong families help establish healthy foundations for faith, relationships, and personal growth. Understanding God's design for family helps believers navigate challenges with greater wisdom, patience, and grace.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Invest intentionally in family relationships. Prioritize prayer, communication, forgiveness, and spiritual growth within the home. Remember that family discipleship often happens through daily faithfulness rather than occasional grand moments.
